description: This file defines UI-related components and layout constants for a canvas window in a macOS application, including a custom NSPanel subclass, layout size constants, and an enum representing different presentation modes.

classes.name: CanvasPanel
classes.description: A subclass of NSPanel that can become key and main window.

methods.name: canBecomeKey
methods.description: Overrides the property to allow the panel to become key.

methods.name: canBecomeMain
methods.description: Overrides the property to allow the panel to become the main window.
